# rapttor/yii2-metadata

> Yii2 component: per-record JSON metadata in one shared table (key, remote_table, remote_id -> content, history, rev). get/value/set/patch/modify with revision check, history of replaced values, export and delete per account. No runtime dependencies besides Yii2.

Integrating or changing this package: read AGENTS.md first.

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): when to use it, integration steps, account deletion and export, rules
- [README.md](README.md): install, config, API, guarantees
- [src/Metadata.php](src/Metadata.php): the component
- [src/Schema.php](src/Schema.php) and [src/migrations/](src/migrations/): the table
- [tests/MetadataTest.php](tests/MetadataTest.php): behaviour covered (history, cap, concurrency, export, delete)
- Used by https://github.com/rapttor/yii2-legal for consents (`key=legal`, `remote_table=profile`)
